| [`set_stack_type`](methods/set_stack_type.md) | Select the frame type that the stacker accumulates (light, dark, bias or flat) and, for flat, an auto-exposure flag. |
| [`set_subframe`](methods/set_subframe.md) | Set the camera crop (sub-frame) rectangle, in pixels. |
| [`set_test_setting`](methods/set_test_setting.md) | Change the device test/hot settings (heater, cooler, 5 GHz station, goto simulation flags). |
| [`set_view_plan`](methods/set_view_plan.md) | Start the ViewPlan scheduling worker, either with a new inline plan or by re-running the plan the device holds. |
| [`set_view_plan_target_name`](methods/set_view_plan_target_name.md) | Set the target name that the device uses for the current view and for autosaved captures. |
| [`set_view_plan_wide_setting`](methods/set_view_plan_wide_setting.md) | Set the wide-camera capture type, frame size and optional exposure settings used by view plans, saving the previous settings for later restore. |
| [`set_wheel_position`](methods/set_wheel_position.md) | Start moving the filter wheel to slot 0, 1 or 2. |
| [`set_wheel_setting`](methods/set_wheel_setting.md) | Update the filter-wheel slot names and/or per-slot exposure times. |
| [`set_wheel_slot_name`](methods/set_wheel_slot_name.md) | Replace the filter-wheel slot names with an array of strings. |
| [`set_wheel_unidirection`](methods/set_wheel_unidirection.md) | Set the wheel unidirectional-movement flag; in firmware 9.31 it always fails and applies nothing. |
| [`set_wifi_country`](methods/set_wifi_country.md) | Set the Wi-Fi regulatory country of the device. |
| [`start_ai_process`](methods/start_ai_process.md) | Start the AI image-processing worker on the current or a named image. |
| [`start_annotate`](methods/start_annotate.md) | Start or restart annotation of the current in-memory image or of a named image file. |
| [`start_auto_focuse`](methods/start_auto_focuse.md) | Start autofocus (method name is spelled start_auto_focuse). |
| [`start_auto_goto`](methods/start_auto_goto.md) | Start the auto-goto worker towards an RA/Dec target. |
| [`start_auto_goto_pixel`](methods/start_auto_goto_pixel.md) | Start the auto-goto worker towards an image pixel target. |
| [`start_avi_rtmp`](methods/start_avi_rtmp.md) | Start playing a recorded AVI file out through the live-stream output. |
| [`start_batch_stack`](methods/start_batch_stack.md) | Start the batch stacking worker over the configured input list. |
| [`start_compass_auto_calibration`](methods/start_compass_auto_calibration.md) | Calibrate the compass by rotating the mount automatically (firmware 9.75). |
| [`start_compass_calibration`](methods/start_compass_calibration.md) | Begin compass-sensor sampling for a compass calibration run (resets the sample buffer and starts the sampling timer). |
| [`start_create_calib_frame`](methods/start_create_calib_frame.md) | Start the calibration-frame creation worker (automatic or custom bias/flat). |
| [`start_create_dark`](methods/start_create_dark.md) | Start the dark-frame creation worker. |
| [`start_create_hpc`](methods/start_create_hpc.md) | Start creation of the hot-pixel correction (HPC) calibration. |
| [`start_demonstrate`](methods/start_demonstrate.md) | Stop the current view and start the demonstration function. |
| [`start_export_image`](methods/start_export_image.md) | Start an asynchronous copy or move of saved images from one storage volume to another. |
| [`start_exposure`](methods/start_exposure.md) | Start capture in the current exposure mode, optionally selecting the frame type. |
| [`start_find_star`](methods/start_find_star.md) | Start the star-detection worker on the current image or a named file. |
| [`start_func`](methods/start_func.md) | Start the GoPixel function: centre the mount on a displayed-image pixel. |
| [`start_gsensor_calibration`](methods/start_gsensor_calibration.md) | Start the gravity-sensor calibration worker. |
| [`start_motion_monitor`](methods/start_motion_monitor.md) | Start the motion monitor: watch the scene for movers, then track or capture (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only). |
| [`start_planet_stack`](methods/start_planet_stack.md) | Stack a recorded planetary, lunar or solar video file into an image on a worker thread. |
| [`start_polar_align`](methods/start_polar_align.md) | Start (or restart) polar alignment. |
| [`start_record_avi`](methods/start_record_avi.md) | Start recording the live view to a video file, optionally as a timelapse. |
| [`start_scan_planet`](methods/start_scan_planet.md) | Launch the sun/moon scan worker. |
| [`start_scope_move_round`](methods/start_scope_move_round.md) | Start the scope movement round used while sampling compass data (requires an active compass sampling run). |
| [`start_single_expose`](methods/start_single_expose.md) | Switch to the exposure page and start one asynchronous exposure. |
| [`start_smart_follow`](methods/start_smart_follow.md) | Start smart follow: detect a mover and track it (firmware 9.75). |
| [`start_solve`](methods/start_solve.md) | Start a plate solve, either of the live image or of a named stored image. |
| [`start_stack`](methods/start_stack.md) | Enter the stacking stage of the star view and start its worker. |
| [`start_track_object`](methods/start_track_object.md) | Start tracking an object inside a user-supplied rectangle on the live image. |
| [`start_view_star_sleep`](methods/start_view_star_sleep.md) | Start the Sleep view stage (view stage 4) on the open camera. |
| [`stop_annotate`](methods/stop_annotate.md) | Stop the annotation worker, waiting for it to finish. |
| [`stop_auto_focuse`](methods/stop_auto_focuse.md) | Cancel autofocus (method name is spelled stop_auto_focuse). |
| [`stop_auto_goto`](methods/stop_auto_goto.md) | Stop the auto-goto worker. |
| [`stop_avi_rtmp`](methods/stop_avi_rtmp.md) | Stop the AVI playback thread started by start_avi_rtmp and wait for it to exit. |
| [`stop_batch_stack`](methods/stop_batch_stack.md) | Stop the batch stacking worker. |
| [`stop_compass_calibration`](methods/stop_compass_calibration.md) | Finish or cancel the compass calibration run: with force 0 compute from the collected samples, with nonzero force discard them. |
| [`stop_create_dark`](methods/stop_create_dark.md) | Abort the dark-frame creation worker. |
| [`stop_demonstrate`](methods/stop_demonstrate.md) | Stop the demonstration function and wait for its thread to exit. |
| [`stop_export_image`](methods/stop_export_image.md) | Stop the running image export and return its progress counters. |
| [`stop_exposure`](methods/stop_exposure.md) | Abort the running exposure or capture, optionally waiting for the worker to finish. |
| [`stop_find_star`](methods/stop_find_star.md) | Stop the star-detection worker. |
| [`stop_focuser`](methods/stop_focuser.md) | Stop any focuser motion. |
| [`stop_func`](methods/stop_func.md) | Stop a named running function, then relay the stop to the peer process. |
| [`stop_gsensor_calibration`](methods/stop_gsensor_calibration.md) | Stop the gravity-sensor calibration worker. |
| [`stop_lock_sun`](methods/stop_lock_sun.md) | Stop the lock-on-sun worker thread and the sun-finding scan. |
| [`stop_motion_monitor`](methods/stop_motion_monitor.md) | Stop the motion monitor (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only). |
| [`stop_planet_stack`](methods/stop_planet_stack.md) | Signal the planet-stack worker to stop and wait for it. |
| [`stop_polar_align`](methods/stop_polar_align.md) | Stop polar alignment and restore settings if it was active. |
| [`stop_record_avi`](methods/stop_record_avi.md) | Ask the AVI recording threads to stop, or relay the stop to the peer unit. |
| [`stop_send`](methods/stop_send.md) | Set the stop flag that ends the image-sending loop on the secondary image service. |
| [`stop_smart_follow`](methods/stop_smart_follow.md) | Stop smart follow (firmware 9.75). |
| [`stop_solve`](methods/stop_solve.md) | Stop the plate-solve worker and wait for it to end. |
| [`stop_stack`](methods/stop_stack.md) | Stop the Stack function worker. |
| [`stop_track_object`](methods/stop_track_object.md) | Stop the object tracker (firmware 9.75). |
| [`test`](methods/test.md) | Developer diagnostic that loads a fixed image (64-bit build) or reference file (32-bit build) and discards it. |
| [`test_connection`](methods/test_connection.md) | Heartbeat: returns a fixed connected string. |
| [`trigger_test_crash`](methods/trigger_test_crash.md) | Deliberately crash the control process (crash-reporter test hook). |
| [`update_comet_txt`](methods/update_comet_txt.md) | Install a previously staged comet-data file after checking its MD5 against the supplied value. |
| [`upload_refstar_info`](methods/upload_refstar_info.md) | Store a list of reference stars on the device for later use. |
| [`verify_client`](methods/verify_client.md) | Prove the client application by returning a signature over this socket's challenge. |

## Events

| Name | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`3PPA`](events/3PPA.md) | Three-point polar-alignment progress, from two different producers under one Event name. |
| [`AIProcess`](events/AIProcess.md) | State of the AI denoise worker. |
| [`Alert`](events/Alert.md) | Fault notification, in one of two shapes (code/error, or Msg/Type), including the connection-limit rejection. |
| [`Annotate`](events/Annotate.md) | Annotation workflow notification (start, result, failure) from the direct sender or the function detail. |
| [`AppStateChange`](events/AppStateChange.md) | Notification that a reconnection changed the active page or state, or resumed an exposure or loop. |
| [`AutoExp`](events/AutoExp.md) | Function-state notification of the auto-exposure loop, with the chosen exposure on completion. |
| [`AutoFocus`](events/AutoFocus.md) | Autofocus progress and result, from the function detail and the direct V-curve callback. |
| [`AutoGoto`](events/AutoGoto.md) | Auto-goto (slew, solve, re-centre) progress from the function detail and the legacy retry notifier. |
| [`AutoGotoStep`](events/AutoGotoStep.md) | Mount-error notification raised during an auto-goto step. |
| [`AutoOpenDevice`](events/AutoOpenDevice.md) | Notification that the automatic reconnect logic reopened a device. |
| [`AviRecord`](events/AviRecord.md) | Video recording progress (AVI/MP4, optionally timelapse). |
| [`AviRtmp`](events/AviRtmp.md) | State of playing a recorded AVI file out through the live-stream output. |
| [`BalanceSensor`](events/BalanceSensor.md) | Tilt/accelerometer sample with a validity code, sent from the 100 ms sensor timer when it changes. |
| [`BatchStack`](events/BatchStack.md) | Progress of the batch stacking worker over stored frames. |
| [`BattHiTempShutdown`](events/BattHiTempShutdown.md) | Envelope-only warning sent just before the device shuts down for battery over-temperature. |
| [`CalibGSensor`](events/CalibGSensor.md) | Function-state notification of the gravity-sensor calibration worker. |
| [`CameraStateChange`](events/CameraStateChange.md) | Envelope-only notification that the camera was opened or closed. |
| [`CheckPhotoMetry`](events/CheckPhotoMetry.md) | State of the photometry check stage, with the solved coordinate at completion. |
| [`Client`](events/Client.md) | Guest-mode client list, personalized per recipient with whether that socket is the master. |
| [`CompassCalibration`](events/CompassCalibration.md) | Progress and result of the compass (magnetometer) calibration worker. |
| [`ContinuousExposure`](events/ContinuousExposure.md) | Function-state notification of the continuous capture (Imaging) loop, with frame rate. |
| [`CreateCalibFrame`](events/CreateCalibFrame.md) | State of the calibration-frame (bias/flat) creation worker. |
| [`CreateHPC`](events/CreateHPC.md) | State of hot-pixel correction (HPC) creation. |
| [`DarkLibrary`](events/DarkLibrary.md) | Progress and state of dark-frame (dark library) creation, from the imager or the guider. |
| [`Demonstrate`](events/Demonstrate.md) | Function-state notification of the demonstration mount loop. |
| [`DeviceChange`](events/DeviceChange.md) | Hot-plug notification for storage, serial or camera devices arriving or leaving. |
| [`DiskEject`](events/DiskEject.md) | Queued storage-eject status notification. |
| [`DiskSpace`](events/DiskSpace.md) | One-member delta reporting the used-storage percentage when it changes. |
| [`Dither`](events/Dither.md) | Imager-side dither: move the guide lock and wait for the guider's settle-done. |
| [`EqModePA`](events/EqModePA.md) | State of the equatorial-mode polar-alignment worker, with the error at completion. |
| [`ExportImage`](events/ExportImage.md) | Progress of copying or moving saved images between storage volumes. |
| [`Exposure`](events/Exposure.md) | Exposure progress from two producers: the legacy page/start/downloading/complete/fail sender and the function-state Exposure detail. |
| [`FactoryTestControl`](events/FactoryTestControl.md) | Outcome of a factory_test_control operation, sent immediately or from the deferred completion callback. |
| [`FindStar`](events/FindStar.md) | Star-detection worker notification: start, complete with the detected stars, or fail. |
| [`FirstDelay`](events/FirstDelay.md) | Legacy autosave the first-frame delay start and end. |
| [`FocuserMove`](events/FocuserMove.md) | Focuser movement state with the resulting position. |
| [`FrameDelay`](events/FrameDelay.md) | Legacy autosave the between-frame delay start and end. |
| [`GSensorMove`](events/GSensorMove.md) | Envelope-only notification that the motion sensor detected the device or mount being moved. |
| [`GoPixel`](events/GoPixel.md) | Function-state notification of the centre-on-pixel function, with the current pixel position. |
| [`Initialise`](events/Initialise.md) | Function-state notification of the view-setup Initialise function. |
| [`LoopingFrames`](events/LoopingFrames.md) | Legacy exposure loop start, end or failure. |
| [`MeridianFlip`](events/MeridianFlip.md) | Legacy meridian flip: range entry, flip and retry. |
| [`MotionDetection`](events/MotionDetection.md) | State of the standalone motion detector (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only). |
| [`MotionMonitor`](events/MotionMonitor.md) | State of the motion-monitor worker (firmware 9.75, 64-bit only). |
| [`MountSettle`](events/MountSettle.md) | Legacy meridian flip: waiting for the mount to settle. |
| [`MountUpdate`](events/MountUpdate.md) | Mount-controller firmware write worker state. |
| [`ObjectTrack`](events/ObjectTrack.md) | State of the object tracker with the tracked rectangle. |
| [`PiStatus`](events/PiStatus.md) | Sparse delta of device power and thermal status (SoC temperature, battery, charger, Type-C). |
| [`PlanetStack`](events/PlanetStack.md) | Progress and result of stacking a recorded planetary/lunar/solar video. |
| [`PlateSolve`](events/PlateSolve.md) | Plate-solve begin/progress/result, from the direct solve sender and the function-state detail. |
| [`RTSP`](events/RTSP.md) | State of the RTSP live stream, with stream port and ROI scale. |
| [`RestartGuide`](events/RestartGuide.md) | Imager restarts guiding after a goto or a retry. |
| [`SaveImage`](events/SaveImage.md) | State of saving the current image, with the saved name on success. |
| [`ScanSun`](events/ScanSun.md) | State of the sun/moon scan worker. |
| [`ScopeGoto`](events/ScopeGoto.md) | Mount slew worker state (guider slew, or the imager's nested goto parent). |
| [`ScopeMoveRound`](events/ScopeMoveRound.md) | End-of-round notification from the scope move-round worker, carrying only a success/fail result. |
| [`SecondView`](events/SecondView.md) | Function-state notification of the view function in the auxiliary (wide) imager process. |
| [`SelectCamera`](events/SelectCamera.md) | Notification that the selected imaging process (main or wide view) changed. |
| [`Sequence`](events/Sequence.md) | Legacy autosave sequence and frame transitions. |
| [`Setting`](events/Setting.md) | Sparse notification of changed device settings, with serializer-added companions. |
| [`Settle`](events/Settle.md) | Imager-side wait for guiding to settle (dither or guide start). |
| [`SkyReplay`](events/SkyReplay.md) | State of the sky replay recorder (firmware 9.75). |
| [`Sleep`](events/Sleep.md) | Function-state notification of the view Sleep stage. |
| [`SmartFollow`](events/SmartFollow.md) | State of the smart-follow worker (firmware 9.75). |
| [`Stack`](events/Stack.md) | Stacking progress: per-frame counters from the frame producer and function-state updates. |
| [`Station`](events/Station.md) | Result of a Wi-Fi station-mode connection attempt, with the station state on success. |
| [`Target`](events/Target.md) | Per-target state of a running ViewPlan (and of the legacy autosave plan). |
| [`TargetChange`](events/TargetChange.md) | Legacy autosave plan moved to another target (no members). |
| [`TargetDelay`](events/TargetDelay.md) | Legacy autosave the between-target delay start and end. |
| [`Version`](events/Version.md) | Connection greeting sent to a newly accepted socket, naming the server and (imager only) its firmware version. |
| [`View`](events/View.md) | Function-state notification of the main view function, with view mode and target metadata. |
| [`ViewPlan`](events/ViewPlan.md) | Device-initiated notification of the ViewPlan worker state, with the held plan attached. |
| [`ViewTargetNameChanged`](events/ViewTargetNameChanged.md) | Notification that the current view target name was replaced by an accepted or matched name. |
| [`WheelMove`](events/WheelMove.md) | Filter-wheel movement start, completion with position, or failure. |
| [`WheelSlotNum`](events/WheelSlotNum.md) | Discovered filter-wheel slot names. |
